title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE (300 affected)
summary: THE ROUTING OF THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE CAN ALLOW HEAT FROM THE AIR DISCHARGE LINE TO MELT THE CABLE.

title: Capacity of Texas: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:AIR SUPPLY:RESERVOIR:WET:DRY (5 affected)
summary: THE FRONT AND REAR SERVICE BRAKE RESERVOIR IS PLUMBED SO A SINGLE POINT FAILURE CAN EMPTY BOTH RESERVOIRS. THIS PLUMBING ALLOWS AIR FROM THE WET TANK TO GO THROUGH ONE OF THE REAR SERVICE RESERVOIRS BEFORE ENTERING THE FRONT SYSTEM SERVICE RESERVOIR. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 121, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL:RELEASE MECHANI (135,000 affected)
summary: THE PARKING BRAKE HANDLE RELEASE BUTTON CAN SEPARATE FROM THE PARKING BRAKE HANDLE ASSEMBLY, CAUSING THE PARKING BRAKE TO BE INOPERATIVE.

title: General Motors, LLC: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:LOWER (69 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE ASSEMBLED WITH THE LEFT-HAND LOWER CONTROL ARM-TO-FRAME REAR NUT NOT TIGHTENED TO THE SPECIFIED TORQUE.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: POWER TRAIN:DRIVELINE (INDICATOR FORWARD OR REVERS (651 affected)
summary: THE DRIVELINE COULD HAVE LITTLE TORQUE OR NO TORQUE ON THE DRIVELINE NUT THAT RETAINS THE YOKE AT THE CENTER BEARING OR BEARINGS IF THE VEHICLE IS EQUIPPED WITH MULTIPLE CENTER BEARINGS.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM (2,216,325 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE ASSEMBLED WITH REAR OUTBOARD SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGES THAT MAY NOT WITHSTAND THE REQUIRED LOAD. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO.210, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES."

title: UD Trucks Corporation: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING (890 affected)
summary: THE ELECTRICAL WIRING HARNESS PROTECTOR BEHIND THE BATTERY BOX CAN CHAFE OR RUB ON THE DRIVER'S SIDE LOWER FRAME RAIL FLANGE CAUSING POSSIBLE FAILURE OF THE WIRING HARNESS PROTECTOR AND EXPOSURE OR BREAKAGE OF THE WIRING.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:PEDALS:LINKAGES AND VALVES (192 affected)
summary: A STOP LIGHT SWITCH ON THE BRAKE TREADLE VALVE AND A CRUISE CONTROL DUMP VALVE SWITCH WERE OMITTED DURING ASSEMBLY OR BOTH SWITCHES WERE INSTALLED BUT WERE NOT WIRED CORRECTLY.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN (34,000 affected)
summary: IMPROPER MATERIAL WAS USED IN MANUFACTURING THE RADIATOR FAN MOTOR SHAFT CAUSING THE SHAFT TO WEAR AND BECOME NOISY.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC (745 affected)
summary: THE FUEL HOSE TO THE FUEL FILTER IS ROUTED TOO CLOSE TO THE ALTERNATOR BELT CAUSING THE ALTERNATOR BELT TO RUB THE FUEL HOSE. THIS CAN CAUSE A FUEL LEAK.

title: General Motors, LLC: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN (73,163 affected)
summary: FAN BLADE RIVET BREAKAGE CAN OCCUR CAUSING THE FAN BLADE TO SEPARATE FROM THE SPIDER.

title: Skyline Corporation: FURNACE:RECREATIONAL VEHICLE (100 affected)
summary: THE FURNACES WERE IMPROPERLY INSTALLED. A 1 1/4" MINIMUM OVERLAP BETWEEN THE CHAMBER EXHAUST TUBE AND THE VENT ASSEMBLY EXHAUST IS NEEDED FOR PROPER EXHAUST.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: EQUIPMENT:BUNK SLEEPER:TRUCK (1,843 affected)
summary: STRAPS HOLDING THE SLEEPER UPPER BUNK IN THE RAISED POSITION CAN RELEASE WITHOUT WARNING.

title: DYNAMIC ELECTRONICS MFG.: EQUIPMENT:ELECTRIC POWER ACCESSORIES (60,000 affected)
summary: SOME OF THESE DEVICES HAVE EXPERIENCED AN ELECTRICAL SHORTING WITHIN THE MODULE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT: INTEGRAL PART OF SEAT (5,224 affected)
THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: FUEL:CNG: PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE/DEVICE (75 affected)
summary: SOME TEMPERATURE SENSITIVE TRIGGERS WERE NOT X-RAYED. THESE TRIGGERS COULD CONTAIN INTERNAL VOIDS THAT WOULD MAKE THE TRIGGERS SUSCEPTIBLE TO ADVANCED CREEP CAUSING FALSE ACTIVATION AND VENTING OF THE CNG.

title: LINCOLN COMPOSITES: FUEL:CNG: PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE/DEVICE (4,750 affected)
summary: SOME TEMPERATURE SENSITIVE TRIGGERS WERE NOT X-RAYED. THESE TRIGGERS COULD CONTAIN INTERNAL VOIDS THAT WOULD MAKE THE TRIGGERS SUSCEPTIBLE TO ADVANCED CREEP CAUSING FALSE ACTIVATION AND VENTING OF THE CNG.
